note: The gate registry the CAPTURE fixtures resolve against. Separate from
src/gate-registry.json so a fixture never has to be admitted as a real
gate of this repository to exercise a capture branch.
`terrain-dynamic` stands for the real shape kogaki#818 was filed on: a
gate whose CLASS-level declaration is one standing option, with the rest
composed per run. Its static list is deliberately NOT what the run offers,
which is what lets the fixture pair discriminate the two readings of the
REPOINTED AT kogaki#1087. The pair was shaped after the Strand-selection
gate, which that issue deleted; the SHAPE it exercises is unchanged and is
now `terrain-tag-selection`'s, which carries exactly one standing option
beside per-run composed ones. The synthetic id stays `terrain-dynamic`: it
is this fixture's own key and never a registered gate of this repository,
which is the whole point of the separate registry above.
